issuing_body: 人工知能戦略本部 (AI Strategy Headquarters, Cabinet Office, Japan)
covered_actors: 研究開発機関 (AI research and development institutions)
活用事業者 (AI utilization businesses, including foreign operators)
地方公共団体 (local public entities)
prohibited_practices: Use of AI to generate or spread false/misinformation including deepfake videos and sexually manipulated images
Use of AI to promote unjust bias or discrimination
Unfair data collection by entities with dominant AI resource positions
enforcement_authorities: 人工知能戦略本部 (AI Strategy Headquarters)
implementation_notes: This guideline is issued under Article 13 of the AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025). It promotes voluntary and proactive compliance rather than mandating specific binding obligations. Actors are expected to apply measures proportionate to their scale, role, and AI risk level. The guideline references the Hiroshima AI Process International Code of Conduct and ISO/IEC 42001 as applicable international norms. The document is intended to be reviewed and updated in an agile manner as AI technology evolves.
